description: Source code for utility functions related to Protobuf schema handling in Apache Spark, including descriptor building, schema matching, and dependency parsing.

classes.name: ProtoMatchedField
classes.description: Wrapper for a pair of matched fields, one Catalyst and one Protobuf field.

classes.name: ProtoSchemaHelper
classes.description: Helper class to perform field lookup/matching on Protobuf schemas, validating schema consistency.

methods.name: buildDescriptor
methods.description: Builds a Protobuf Descriptor from message name and optional binary descriptor set.

methods.name: buildDescriptorFromJavaClass
methods.description: Loads a Protobuf class and returns its Descriptor.

methods.name: buildDescriptor
methods.description: Builds a Descriptor from a binary FileDescriptorSet and message name.

methods.name: parseFileDescriptorSet
methods.description: Parses a byte array into a list of FileDescriptors.

methods.name: buildFileDescriptor
methods.description: Recursively constructs FileDescriptor from proto and dependencies.

methods.name: createDescriptorProtoMap
methods.description: Creates a map from descriptor proto names to protos.

methods.name: toFieldStr
methods.description: Converts hierarchical field names to a human-readable string.

methods.name: buildTypeRegistry
methods.description: Builds a TypeRegistry from descriptor bytes.

methods.name: buildTypeRegistry
methods.description: Builds a TypeRegistry from a Descriptor.
